name: b2-plan-quality-eval
_provenance: Five SYNTHETIC stories. PCC-DEMO-1 (the Milestone A demo story) is excluded because it is the only story whose recording was used during development of prompts/validators.
recordings_policy: PCC-DEMO-2..6 have hand-authored STUB/REPLAY answers in fixtures/replay/ used ONLY to self-test the harness offline. They are never included in prompts (the prompt contains only system rules, the catalog and the story). In --provider grok mode the harness refuses stub/loopback endpoints and flags any plan identical to a recorded answer as contaminated. PCC-DEMO-7 is held out: no stub recording, sealed gold; it is evaluated only with a live provider.

PCC-DEMO-7.custody: outside the repository; to be handed to the QA lead / Ankit. Provide with --sealed-gold-dir at scoring time.
